title: GLM and Logistic regression
---

## Setup

Read the textbook chapter -  [GLM 1](https://websites.umich.edu/~thofer/teach/hhcr-book/glm_1.html) and [Logistic regression](https://websites.umich.edu/~thofer/teach/hhcr-book/logistic_reg.html)

The data for the problems in the Application section of this chapter can be loaded by running the following commands:

Problem 1-3

```stata
use https://tphofer.github.io/ncsp-hhcr/data/cvd_data.dta
```

Problem 5

```stata
import delimited using "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avehtari/ROS-Examples/master/Arsenic/data/wells.csv", clear
sum educ4,meanonly
gen c_educ4=educ4-r(mean)
sum dist100,meanonly
gen c_dist100=dist100-r(mean)
sum arsenic,meanonly
gen c_arsenic=arsenic-r(mean)
qui logit switch educ4 c_dist10 c_arsenic c.c_arsenic#c.c_educ4  c.c_dist100#c.c_educ4
```

These commands load the data for the problems so you can follow along with the code presented in class.
